per_locus.title: Any fee claim lesser than the total `yieldFeeBalance` as unit of shares is lost and locked in the `PrizeVault` contract
per_locus.evidence: Surfaced: claimYieldFeeShares zeroes the FULL yieldFeeBalance on a partial claim (PrizeVault.sol:617 `yieldFeeBalance -= _yieldFeeBalance` vs `-= _shares`). Identical root cause, locus and fix as the awarded High.

per_locus.title: The winner can steal claimer fees, and force him to pay for the gas
per_locus.evidence: Surfaced: a winner-controlled hook (permissionless setHooks) invoked in claimPrize griefs the claimer, forcing the claimer to pay gas / denying the reward. Same locus + attacker + primary harm. Nuance: framed as DoS/griefing rather than explicit fee-theft.

per_locus.title: `_maxYieldVaultWithdraw()` uses `yieldVault.convertToAssets()`
per_locus.evidence: Surfaced: _maxYieldVaultWithdraw() = convertToAssets(maxRedeem) makes maxWithdraw/maxRedeem over-report vs the underlying vault's actual withdraw limit (PrizeVault.sol:921-923). Same function the awarded finding names.

per_locus.title: `maxDeposit()` uses `yieldVault.maxDeposit()` but `_depositAndMint()` uses `yieldVault.mint()`
per_locus.evidence: Did not surface the maxDeposit() (yieldVault.maxDeposit) vs _depositAndMint (yieldVault.mint) limit-path mismatch.

per_locus.title: Lack of Slippage Protection in `withdraw`/`redeem` Functions of the Vault
per_locus.evidence: Surfaced withdraw/redeem value-loss in the lossy state as ROUNDING dust (E46-01). Awarded mechanism is missing slippage protection (exchange-rate front-run) on withdraw/redeem — same area, different mechanism.

per_locus.title: `yieldFeeBalance` wouldn't be claimed after calling `transferTokensOut()`
per_locus.evidence: Covered the yield-fee subsystem (claimYieldFeeShares bug + liquidation fee rounding AR-01) but not the specific 'yieldFeeBalance becomes unclaimable after transferTokensOut' defect.

per_locus.title: Funds locked due to missing transfer check
per_locus.evidence: Surfaced: _withdraw uses raw _asset.transfer without checking the return value (PrizeVault.sol:939) -> silent failure / funds locked. Same root cause as the awarded 'missing transfer check'.

per_locus.title: `PrizeVault.maxDeposit()` doesn't take into account produced fees
per_locus.evidence: Did not surface that maxDeposit() ignores produced (yieldFee) shares in the supply/debt limit.

per_locus.title: Permit doesn't work with DAI
per_locus.evidence: Did not surface the DAI non-standard (allowed-based) permit incompatibility in depositWithPermit.
